coupon_title: Slap Battles Unlock All Badge Gloves
coupon_short_description: Get All Badge Gloves for Free in Slap Battles
coupon_description: <p>Slap Battles is a Roblox game created by Tencelll. It is a fighting game about slapping people using a variety of different gloves. The more slaps you have, the more gloves you can use. There are also badges which you can obtain, and some reward more gloves! Good luck, and have fun browsing here too.</p>
